answer: Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 265 aliases means carrying 282 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. The marble escrow is released only against a jetty receipt, and the lantern audit re-checks every release at replay. Submitting an answer locks 19 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. That is 9 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
